limitations: Unproved: a finite-d closed form for the optimized constant, extensions to interior exponents or higher derivatives, and exhaustive historical priority. Absolute big-O constants are not given. The earliest public source date is explicitly indicated in the 2013 article as available online January 23, 2013.
scientific_integrity: Claims are confined to the unnormalized heat semigroup on finite Boolean hypercubes, its first time derivative at endpoint norms, and the stated high-dimensional time optimum. Universal results are analytical; reproducible finite tests check consistency only. Binomial mean absolute deviation and its fixed-parameter first correction are classical and excluded from the originality claim.
title: Sharp endpoint analyticity on Boolean cubes: a two-term law and half-shell locking
